description: The searches Google showed a site's pages for, from Search Console, with clicks, impressions and average place: by query, by page, or only those close to the top (places 4 to 20). Only sites whose owner added mttr in Search Console have any. Queries come under "quoted".

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next part of a long list.

page.description: A full page address, to list only the queries that page was shown for.

show.description: queries (the default), pages, near: queries close to the top, unanswered: searches no passage on the site comes close to, brand searches left out, or better: searches another page reads closer to than the one Google shows. The last two are most seen first.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_queries
title: Get search queries
